title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“这是黄雨锋，我新收的弟子，今后便是你们的小师弟。”众人得知又添新成员，皆感欢喜。介绍完黄雨锋后，黄药师嘱咐仆人将他带去休憩，毕竟还是婴儿，长途跋涉需好好休息。夜晚，所有人都安歇后，黄雨锋开始悄悄启动系统。白天他一直忍着没动，现在终于可以安心探索了。黄雨锋呼唤系统：“系统，你在这里吗？给我介绍一下你的功能。”“主人，我在呢。我是签到系统，在每个特别的地方或场合都能触发签到。”系统回应道。“签到奖励来自无数世界，包括**、宝物、体质、人物等，应有尽有，只有你想不到的，没有系统签不到的。”系统继续说道。“不过这得看你运气，运气不好时，签到的可能是杂草。”系统稍作停顿，补充道：“签到的生灵都对你绝对忠诚，不用担忧。”听到系统如此强大，黄雨锋兴奋不已。要是能签到出厉害的修仙**，那就轻松碾压这个世界了。不过这只是想想罢了，即便现在签到到修仙，也不一定适合自己。“系统，打开新手大礼包。”黄雨锋迫不及待地要求。“叮！恭喜主人开启新手大礼包，获得《乾坤诀》，以及特殊《敛息术》，已放入系统空间，请主人查收。”“系统，这《乾坤诀》是什么？看起来很高级的样子，是不是修仙**或者玄幻世界的修炼方法？”黄雨锋激动地询问，《敛息术》他还能理解，一听名字就知道是用来收敛气息、隐藏实力的。他对《敛息术》比较满意，但对《乾坤诀》一无所知，完全摸不着头脑。“主人，《乾坤诀》目前只是一本普通**，但它具有进化能力。”系统解释说。“主人以后获取的所有，《乾坤诀》都能融合它们的优点。”“换句话说，以后主人获取的所有，你都可以修炼并融合，不用担心功法冲突。”“理论上，《乾坤诀》没有极限，融合的**越多，它就越强，可以无限制地提升。”“它未来能达到的高度，取决于主人的能力，只要你足够强大，它能超越一切。”听完系统说明，黄雨锋无比兴奋，这比那些修仙要好得多，正是适合他，能够伴随他成长，并在未来超越所有仙法。接着，黄雨锋看向系统空间，空间内存放着两本秘籍，是一个边长十米的正方体，体积正好一千立方米，已经相当宽敞。“系统，外面的东西可以放进这个空间里吗？”黄雨锋好奇地问。

“当然可以，不过现在还不支持放入活物。”“系统，你说暂时不行，那以后是不是就能放了？”黄雨锋激动地追问。“是的，主人。当你达到陆地神仙级别，系统空间会升级，那时人也能在里面生存，就像一个随身小世界。你越强，这个小世界也会随之进化。”“系统，陆地神仙是什么等级？给我讲讲这个世界的修炼等级吧。”“主人，这里的实力等级分为：三流、二流、一流、后天、先天、宗师、大宗师、天人、陆地神仙、神话。”“每个境界又细分为初期、中期、后期、圆满四个小阶段。之后还有更高的等级，暂且不提。”“功法和武技等级从低到高为黄、玄、地、天、灵，每级又分上、中、下三品。”“宗师境界可活两百岁。”“大宗师能活三百年。”“天人境则能飞行，寿命达五百年。即便帝王也对天人境强者礼遇有加，不敢轻易招惹。”“而陆地神仙更为恐怖，足以覆灭一国，但他们都深居简出，专注于修炼，寿元可达千年。”“至于神话境界……这个世界确实存在，只是无人知晓。只要你勤加修炼，达到神话并非难事。”黄雨锋听罢震惊不已，这个世界竟如此强大。“系统，确定这是武侠世界吗？这力量未免太夸张了吧？”“主人，这不是普通武侠世界，而是综武世界，别用前世眼光看待它。”“那我师父黄药师现在是什么实力？”“目前黄药师处于宗师后期。”黄雨锋点点头，黄药师不过三十岁左右，正值壮年，宗师境若无意外，活过两百年不成问题。三十多岁便有这样的修为，实属难得。加之此界武者寿元悠长，这点年龄不算什么。“主人，你还有一次签到机会，是否使用？”听到这话，黄雨锋猛然想起此事，差点忘了。他心中充满期待，不知首次签到会带来何物。黄雨锋默默祈祷，希望雨皇大帝和三清老祖保佑他能得到好东西，以后一定会上香答谢。“系统，开始签到。”“叮！”

"This is Huang Yufeng, my new disciple, he will be your junior brother from now on." Everyone was happy to know that there was a new member.After introducing Huang Yufeng, Huang Yaoshi asked his servant to take him to rest. After all, he was still a baby and needed a good rest after a long journey.At night, after everyone had gone to bed, Huang Yufeng began to quietly start the system.He had held back during the day, and now he could finally explore in peace.Huang Yufeng called the system: "System, are you here? Tell me about your functions." "Master, I am here. I am the sign-in system, and sign-in can be triggered in every special place or occasion." The system responded."Sign-in rewards come from countless worlds, including weapons, treasures, physiques, characters, etc. There are everything you can think of. There is nothing the system cannot sign in." The system continued."But it depends on your luck. If you are not lucky, the ones signed in may be weeds." The system paused for a moment and added: "The creatures signed in are absolutely loyal to you, so don't worry." Huang Yufeng was very excited when he heard that the system was so powerful.If you can sign in and produce a powerful immortal cultivator, you can easily crush this world.But this is just a thought. Even if you sign up to cultivate immortality now, it may not be suitable for you."System, open the novice gift package." Huang Yufeng demanded impatiently."Ding! Congratulations to the master for opening the novice gift package. He has obtained the "Qiankun Jue" and the special "Breathe Concentration Technique". They have been placed in the system space. Please check it, master." "System, what is this "Qiankun Jue"? It looks very advanced. Is it a cultivation method for immortality or the fantasy world?" Huang Yufeng asked excitedly. He could still understand the "Breathe Concentration Technique". As soon as he heard the name, he knew that it was used to condense the breath and hide the strength.He was relatively satisfied with the "Breathe Concentration Technique", but he knew nothing about the "Qiankun Jue" and was completely confused."Master, "Qiankun Jue" is currently just an ordinary book, but it has the ability to evolve." The system explained."Everything the master acquires in the future, "Qiankun Jue" can integrate their advantages." "In other words, everything the master acquires in the future, you can practice and fuse without worrying about the conflict of skills." "Theoretically, "Qiankun Jue" has no limit. The more ** it is fused, the stronger it will be, and it can be infinite."The height it can reach in the future depends on the master's ability. As long as you are strong enough, it can surpass everything."After hearing the system description, Huang Yufeng was extremely excited.This is much better than those cultivating immortals. It is suitable for him and can accompany him to grow and surpass all immortal methods in the future.Then, Huang Yufeng looked at the system space. There were two secret books stored in the space. It was a cube with a side length of ten meters and a volume of exactly one thousand cubic meters, which was quite spacious."System, can things from outside be put into this space?" Huang Yufeng asked curiously.

"Of course you can, but it doesn't support putting in living animals yet." "System, you said it's not possible for the time being, but will it be possible in the future?" Huang Yufeng asked excitedly."Yes, Master. When you reach the level of Land Immortal, the system space will be upgraded, and people can survive in it, just like a small portable world. The stronger you are, the smaller world will evolve accordingly." "System, what level is Land Immortal? Tell me about the cultivation level of this world." "Master."People, the levels of strength here are divided into: third-rate, second-rate, acquired, innate, master, great master, heavenly being, land god, myth.""Each realm is divided into four small stages: early stage, middle stage, late stage, and perfection.There will be higher levels after that, let's not mention the level of skills and martial arts.From low to high are Huang, Xuan, Earth, Heaven, and Spirit. Each level is divided into three levels: upper, middle and lower.""The Grand Master can live for three hundred years." "The Heavenly Realm can fly and has a lifespan of five hundred years.Even the emperor is more polite to the powerful ones in the Heavenly Realm and dare not provoke them easily."It's terrifying enough to destroy a country, but they all live in seclusion and focus on cultivation, and their lifespans can last for thousands of years."As for the mythical realm... this world does exist, but no one knows it. As long as you practice hard, it is not difficult to reach the mythical realm."Huang Yufeng was shocked after hearing this."System, are you sure this is the world of martial arts? Isn't this power too exaggerated?" "Master, this is not the world of ordinary martial arts, but the world of mixed martial arts. Don't look at it from the perspective of the previous life." "Then what is the strength of my master Huang Yaoshi now?" "Currently, Huang Yaoshi is in the late stage of grandmaster." Huang Yufeng nodded. Huang Yaoshi was only about thirty years old and in his prime. If nothing unexpected happens in the grandmaster realm, it will not be a problem to live for two hundred years.It is really rare to have such cultivation in your thirties.In addition, warriors in this world have long lifespans, so age is nothing."Master, you have one more chance to sign in, do you want to use it?" Upon hearing this, Huang Yufeng suddenly remembered the matter and almost forgot about it.He was filled with anticipation, not knowing what his first signing would bring.Huang Yufeng prayed silently, hoping that the Rain Emperor and the ancestors of the Three Qing Dynasties would bless him and get good things, and he would definitely offer incense to express his gratitude in the future."System, start signing in." "Ding!"
